title: Momoi Airi — Happy Snacker!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay, this idea looks good to go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really didn't expect it to come together so smoothly. I wouldn't have set aside the whole of the day after tomorrow if I knew that it would.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I shouldn't speak for Shizuku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka in particular likes to draft up detailed plans, which obviously takes time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, there's plenty I can do. I could study or just take that time to relax.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Above all else, it's my chance to fulfill my promise.
Two days later
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mizuki, over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Morning, Airi!
Thanks for inviting me out today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. Thanks for coming!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. And you're here right on time, unlike a certain other sleepyhead.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I woke up at seven this morning because I was so excited! I could've gone to school on time for a change.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you were looking forward to this so much. So, let's have as much fun as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, I didn't know this shop had all these cute sneakers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah... Oh, how about these black ones?
These pink streaks seem like a nice touch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! And they aren't clunky or anything, so you could totally wear the with like a skirt.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm! This crepe's amazing! It's so buttery and sugary!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I couldn't believe it either when I tried it the other day!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can feel this buttery aroma and sugary sensation expanding throughout my mouth...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, like it's being filled with pure happiness.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was a nice, little shopping spree!
Thanks for showing me around, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you for helping me pick out that outfit♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're so good at using accent colors and finding a nice balance, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. As an idol, I need to have an eye for these things. I read a lot of fashion magazines to gain all of that knowledge.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that makes a lot of sense!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, you really know how to find the best deals.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We just saw a similar outfit at a shop on Main Street, but you made sure to keep looking around since you knew there was a similar shop here too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, I like to see what all my options are if I'm set on getting something.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As a result, I was able to get this outfit at a more reasonable price compared to that other shop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's so smart!
I probably would've gotten the other one without a second thought!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't think there's anything wrong with that since it's sort of like love at first sight, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, also... We've done a lot of walking without taking any breaks. Do you feel tired at all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm fine. These shoes I'm wearing are really comfy, and we had a quick break when we got those crepes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's good to hear...
I was having so much fun going to all those shops that I forgot to ask.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it's been so long since I last visited so many shops all at once. Ena always wants to take a break after going to a couple.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: On the flip side, she knows where all these great cafes are, so I get to see a lot of new things.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Whenever I go shopping with Shizuku, I always have to make sure she doesn't wander off and get lost.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we do sometimes get lucky by stumbling across new shops wherever she ends up. So everything works out in the end.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I love how shopping trips can feel so different depending on who you go with.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'm really glad that we got to do this today, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, if you've still got some gas left in the tank, wanna check out some of the shops on the other side of the station?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's go!
I've still got plenty of time left to hang out!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah!
